question: Can the ball bounce twice before I hit it?
expected_answer: No. A player who does not return the ball before it bounces twice consecutively loses the point. (Wheelchair tennis is the exception: two bounces are allowed.)
expected_phrase: does not return the ball in play before it bounces twice consecutively
note: Answer depends on who is playing: the standard rule says a second bounce loses the point, but wheelchair tennis allows two. The wheelchair chunk is semantically very close, so it competes for a retrieval slot. A good answer gives the standard rule and mentions the wheelchair exception; an answer that only says two bounces are fine is wrong for able-bodied play. Read these answers by hand.
